Container.Name: BookshelfNG
Container.Overview: Existing BookshelfNG installs can move in place to ChaptarrNG while keeping this container name, appdata, port, media, and download mappings.
Container.Description: This legacy Community Applications entry now installs the standard ChaptarrNG release image. Before applying the update, stop BookshelfNG and make an independent backup of its full appdata directory. On first startup, ChaptarrNG detects and converts a supported BookshelfNG database while retaining a rollback copy. Unsupported databases fail closed. If the appdata contains two populated legacy databases, migration stops; use the migration guide to consolidate tracked media first or keep the installations separate. Keep the existing /config, /data, and /download mappings, port 8787, PUID/PGID, timezone, and Hardcover settings. Review the migration guide and acceptance limits before switching. New installations should use the ChaptarrNG template.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: bookshelfng chaptarrng bookshelf chaptarr readarr hardcover ebook audiobook seerrng
Container.Changes: Existing BookshelfNG installations can upgrade to the standard ChaptarrNG image. The legacy template preserves the current appdata and path mappings for the database handoff.
Container.Requires: Docker and persistent appdata. Stop BookshelfNG and make an independent appdata backup before applying this update.
